title: Nine projects joined the directory
summary:
Nine community projects broadened what people can build and explore, while text models and request routing got a round of changes.

Across four days, the directory grew beyond any one kind of AI app: chat interfaces, a text-cultivation sandbox, a database tool, and Berrry Computer’s tweet-to-web-app experiment all joined. Existing listings also got link and credit repairs, making the growing collection easier to explore.

SocialScribe, EzPromptla, Promptgenerator.art, and DeepSeek Prompt added different ways to rewrite text, develop image ideas, preview prompts, and organize templates. Apparently the prompt now has tools of its own.

`llama-fast-roblox`, `mistral-roblox`, and `mistral-nemo-roblox` joined the model lineup. Routing also changed for several existing text models, including `openai-large`.

Nectar-tier queue concurrency rose from 30 to 50, Flower-tier concurrency fell from 10 to 7, and `gptimage` requests below Nectar tier were switched to `flux`. A model-specific semantic cache was merged and then reverted, so that new semantic-match path does not reuse text responses.
